aggregate_admission_observations.cpu_admission: Parent 5 CPU cores; active worker 1 CPU plus support 1 CPU = 2/5 cores.
aggregate_admission_observations.event_attribution_limit: The cgroup memory.max event counter increased by 7 while the separate S4 worker remained active; the retained record cannot attribute those events to this short scope. This run exited successfully below its cap, used no swap, and the OOM counters did not change. The transient scope's MemoryPeak and PID were not retained.

interpretation_limits: The observed delta is small and its paired 95% component-resampling interval crosses zero; this does not establish a benefit or a recipe winner.

Uncertainty covers only resampling of the fixed, previously exposed F0 components. It excludes training-seed, recipe, target/initializer ancestry, inference-precision, fold-transfer and public-transfer uncertainty.
The new and old members differ in recipe and ancestry as well as inference precision (FP32 versus FP16); this screen does not isolate architecture or precision effects.
The result is not a public-score forecast and does not promote, package, or authorize a submission.
